caption_used: Distribution of articles across the three-year collection period (2017-2019), displayed as a pie chart with percentage and count labels. The 2019 cohort (blue) represents the largest share at 46.0% (46 articles), followed by 2018 (orange) at 33.0% (33 articles) and 2017 (green) at 21.0% (21 articles). The distribution reflects a steady annual increase, with the 2018-to-2019 growth rate of approximately 25% exceeding the 2017-to-2018 growth rate of roughly 35%. The combined 2017-2018 corpus accounts for slightly over half of all articles at 54%, suggesting that the collection effort intensified primarily in the final year.

raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This pie chart displays the distribution of articles across the years 2017, 2018, and 2019, with three distinct slices. The largest slice, colored blue and labeled "2019", accounts for 46.0% (46 articles). The second largest slice, colored orange and labeled "2018", represents 33.0% (33 articles). The smallest slice, colored green and labeled "2017", constitutes 21.0% (21 articles). Each slice is labeled with its corresponding year, its percentage, and its count in parentheses. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the top right and moving clockwise. There is no legend, and no slice is exploded or visually emphasized beyond its size and color. Percentage labels are embedded within each slice.
